result.summary: The page is generally well-structured with no critical issues. One notable visual truncation issue was found in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is truncated mid-word ('Piccol' instead of the full name), which could confuse users about the actual restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Since this card is partially visible by design (indicating scrollability), ensure the restaurant name either wraps gracefully or uses an ellipsis at a word boundary rather than cutting mid-word. Alternatively, limit the visible portion of the card so the name area is not shown at all for the partially visible card.
